role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 玛西证明了永恒的忠诚会带来无与伦比的力量，她进入战场时早已准备好高举拳头来捍卫她的伙伴们。她能轻松地抛起战场周围的敌友，也很乐意跃入任何战斗，为友军带来致命的优势，还能释放出潜藏的力量，就连神明也要重新考虑与她作对是否明智。
hero_summary_en: Proving that undying loyalty yields unrivaled power, Marci always marches into battle ready to raise fists in defense of her companions. Effortlessly flinging friends and foes around the battlefield, she happily bounds into any brawl, able to grant allies a deadly edge and unleash a hidden power strong enough to make even gods reconsider the wisdom of a hostile path.

abilities.name: marci_grapple
abilities.description_zh: 玛西抓起一个友方或敌方目标，将其轻松地向她身后摔去，敌方目标将受到伤害并被减速。落地区域内所有敌方单位也会受到伤害并被减速。
abilities.description_en: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.

abilities.name: marci_companion_run
abilities.description_zh:
玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对落地点的敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

回身踢设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，玛西会把她的友军目标带向最终目的地。

友军将获得%ally_movespeed_pct%%%移动速度加成，持续%ally_buff_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
notes_zh: 玛西冲刺时目标单位可以躲避该效果。
多样施法时不会带走被缠绕或束缚的友军。
notes_en: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.

shard_loc.en: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.
shard_loc.zh: 提升伤害。回身踢可以对敌人施放，并且玛西施放后自身也会获得加速效果。

facet_text_en:
When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination. The ally deals %ally_impact_damage_pct%%% of the Rebound damage to the enemies around it's destination.

 Will not apply to Rooted or Leashed allies.

If Marci has Unleash leveled, after landing from Rebound, Marci gains a %postjump_flurry_charges% strike Fury combo. If Unleash is already active, its duration is instead extended by %postjump_unleash_duration%s.

 If upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter, the resulting Unleashed pulse will not silence enemies.
facet_text_zh:
回身踢设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）时，玛西会把目标友军带向她的最终目的地。友军落地时对敌人造成%ally_impact_damage_pct%%%回身踢伤害。

不会影响被缠绕或束缚的友军。

如果玛西已升级怒拳破，回身踢落地后玛西会获得一次%postjump_flurry_charges%拳的狂怒连技。如果怒拳破已经开启，则改为持续时间延长%postjump_unleash_duration%秒。

如果拥有阿哈利姆神杖，本次狂怒连技的脉冲效果不会沉默敌人。

abilities.name: marci_bodyguard
abilities.description_zh:
被动使玛西获得吸血和攻击力加成。

对友军施放时，使其获得她的%max_partner_penalty%%%被动吸血和攻击力加成。另外马上还会给她和她的搭档制造共用的全伤害护盾。在玛西攻击英雄时，造成伤害的%shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%%会补充护盾。
abilities.description_en:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
notes_zh: 玛西无法对自身施放护卫术。
吸血效果对非英雄单位减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。
不论是玛西或她的搭档受到伤害都会使共用护盾的数值减少。
notes_en: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.
facet_text_en: While bodyguarded, Marci and her partner share %shared_healing_percent%%% of health healed by this ability with each other.
facet_text_zh: 在护卫术效果下玛西和她的搭档会共享本技能%shared_healing_percent%%%的生命治疗量。

abilities.name: marci_special_delivery
abilities.description_zh: 玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。所有友方信使被动获得%bonus_levels%级额外等级和%bonus_hp_tooltip%点额外生命。
abilities.description_en: Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.Passively grants all allied couriers %bonus_levels% bonus levels and %bonus_hp_tooltip% bonus health.
notes_zh: 特快专递的口哨具有%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇。
如果信使施放后没有移交任何物品，或还拥有物品，它都会停留在玛西身边。
notes_en: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.

abilities.name: marci_unleash
abilities.description_zh:
玛西释放潜藏的力量，获得狂怒的猛攻效果，使自身可以发动快速的打击，并且降低打击目标的移动和攻击速度，持续%pulse_debuff_duration%秒。每次狂怒连技的最后一击都会创造一个脉冲效果，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。在狂怒连技的间隔，玛西无法攻击，持续%time_between_flurries%秒。

玛西施放怒拳破时移动速度提升%bonus_movespeed%%%。
abilities.description_en:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
notes_zh: 每次狂怒连技开始后，每次攻击都必须在1秒内完成，否则连技将会终止。
notes_en: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.

scepter_loc.en: Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 怒拳破的冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction%秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续%pulse_silence_duration%秒。驱散类型：弱驱散

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_marci_unleash_extend_duration
talents_raw.name_loc: Unleash Duration Extended By {s:bonus_extend_duration}s On Kill
